short: Tensile deformation behavior and mechanical properties of a
title: Tensile deformation behavior and mechanical properties of a bulk cast Al0.9CoFeNi2 eutectic high-entropy alloy

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Deformation substructure evolution of the FCC(L12) and B2 phases during tension of this EHEA is undeciphered. Cr-free Al0.9CoFeNi2 eutectic high-entropy alloy chosen as the base system.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/gap), n2 (DES/base_system), n3 (DES/variable_sweep), n4 (PRC/forming), n7 (PRC/stimulus)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: As-cast alloy is dual-phase ordered FCC (L12) plus ordered BCC (B2). Fully eutectic cells of alternating FCC(L12)/B2 lamellae.
states.detail: Absorbed: n5 (STR/phase/identity), n6 (STR/microstructure/shape), n8 (STR/defect/extended), n9 (STR/defect/extended), n10 (STR/defect/extended), n16 (STR/microstructure/damage)

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Dislocation pile-up at FCC(L12)/B2 boundaries, driven by lattice-mismatch internal stress, raises the yield strength. High tensile strength with ductility: yield 559 MPa, UTS 1005 MPa, elongation 6.2%.
states.detail: Absorbed: n11 (MEC/pathway), n12 (PRP/value), n13 (PRP/value), n14 (PRP/value), n15 (MEC/pathway), n17 (PRP/behavior_class). Premises: Grain and phase boundaries are strong obstacles to dislocation motion; Similar three-stage work hardening reported in some HEAs and steels; Tear ridges indicate ductile fracture; river patterns indicate brittle cleavage

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Coupled soft FCC(L12) and hard B2 lamellae with sequential slip activation give the EHEA its strength-ductility combination

nodes.title: TEM, F1
nodes.head: TEM bright-field: parallel alternating straight lamellae A and B with sharp interfaces
nodes.solves: Fully eutectic cells of alternating FCC(L12)/B2 lamellae
nodes.note: lamella widths ~0.7-0.9 um measured against the 0.5 um bar
nodes.necessity_reason: n6 keeps shown support from o4 after removal.

nodes.title: MICRO, F2, F3, F4, F5
nodes.head: High-magnification fracture: arrowed small holes and boxed microcracks at lamella ends and edges. At first strain step one lamella is featureless while the neighbour shows mottled contrast and line contrast along the interface.
nodes.solves: Voids and microcracks nucleate at FCC/B2 boundaries and B2 lamella ends; B2 lamellae break
nodes.note: markers are drawn symbols; the phase on either side of a crack cannot be told in the SE image discrete dislocation lines are not resolved in the mottled lamella
nodes.necessity_reason: n16, n8, n9, n10 keeps shown support from o7, o16 after removal.

nodes.title: MICRO, F3, F4, F5
nodes.head: Dislocation content rises from unresolved mottled contrast (F3a) to tangled lines (F4a) to dense walls (F5a)
nodes.solves: At 1.5% strain FCC dislocation density rises with slip bands, pile-ups, intersections and networks; B2 still dislocation-free
nodes.necessity_reason: n9 keeps shown support from o15, o17, o18, o19 after removal.

nodes.title: XRD, F1
nodes.head: XRD reflections indexed to L12 (incl. weak superlattice peaks near 25 and 35 deg) and B2 (near 31, 44.6 deg)
nodes.solves: As-cast alloy is dual-phase ordered FCC (L12) plus ordered BCC (B2)
nodes.note: B2 (110) sits as a shoulder at ~44.6 deg beside the L12 (111) at ~43.6 deg; B2 peaks are weak
nodes.necessity_reason: n5 keeps shown support from o2 after removal.

nodes.title: TEM:SAED, F1
nodes.head: SAED of lamella A indexed FCC [011], lamella B BCC [011], each with circled superlattice spots
nodes.solves: As-cast alloy is dual-phase ordered FCC (L12) plus ordered BCC (B2)
nodes.note: superlattice spots circled red (A) and green (B) are visible in pixels
nodes.detail: o2: SAED of lamella A indexed FCC [011], lamella B BCC [011], each with circled superlattice spots
nodes.necessity_reason: n5 keeps shown support from o1 after removal.

nodes.title: EBSD, F1
nodes.head: EBSD phase map: lamellar colonies of two phases radiating from colony boundaries, no single-phase regions
nodes.solves: Fully eutectic cells of alternating FCC(L12)/B2 lamellae
nodes.detail: o4: EBSD phase map: lamellar colonies of two phases radiating from colony boundaries, no single-phase regions
nodes.necessity_reason: n6 keeps shown support from o3 after removal.

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: Interruption strains 0.6% and 1.5% lie past yield, at about 615 and 750 MPa on the curve
nodes.solves: At 0.6% strain dislocations and planar slip appear in FCC lamellae; B2 lamellae stay dislocation-free
nodes.detail: o7: Interruption strains 0.6% and 1.5% lie past yield, at about 615 and 750 MPa on the curve
nodes.necessity_reason: n8 keeps shown support from o14 after removal.

nodes.title: MICRO, F2
nodes.head: Low-magnification fracture surface: tear ridges and elongated grooves following lamellar colonies, scattered holes. Circled flat facet shows faint fine lines (river pattern) within a lamella
nodes.solves: Mixed fracture: ductile tearing of FCC lamellae, brittle cleavage of B2, final separation along phase boundaries
nodes.note: lines inside the blue circle are faint at this resolution
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n17 (o10).

nodes.title: TEM, F3
nodes.head: The 0.6% TEM image shows no resolved pile-up; the 0.6% point already sits past the linear elastic part of F2a
nodes.solves: Dislocation pile-up at FCC(L12)/B2 boundaries, driven by lattice-mismatch internal stress, raises the yield strength
nodes.note: Paper caption calls F3a 'dislocation pileup'; the crop shows mottled contrast in one lamella and a few parallel lines along the lower interface that could be stacked dislocations or thickness fringes, so the absence is 'not resolved' rather than 'absent'. 0.6% lies at ~615 MPa on F2a, where the curve has already bent over (paper's 559 MPa yield is text only).
nodes.necessity_reason: Changes support for S2: a1 partial

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: Engineering curve: yielding near 550-600 MPa, UTS about 1000 MPa, drop to failure near 6.5% strain. Inset true stress rises from ~410 to ~1070 MPa up to 0.06 true strain
nodes.solves: High tensile strength with ductility: yield 559 MPa, UTS 1005 MPa, elongation 6.2%
nodes.op: read characteristic point, replot derived series
nodes.note: failure drop sits at ~6.5% on the axis while the arrow label reads 6.2%; yield 559 MPa is not marked true stress-strain is converted from the engineering curve of F2a
nodes.detail: o6: Engineering curve: yielding near 550-600 MPa, UTS about 1000 MPa, drop to failure near 6.5% strain; o9: Inset true stress rises from ~410 to ~1070 MPa up to 0.06 true strain
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for n12 (o9).

nodes.title: evidence, F2
nodes.head: Hardening rate drops from ~85 to ~14 GPa by 0.009, falls slowly to ~5 GPa by 0.058, then turns negative
nodes.solves: Strain-hardening rate falls in three stages: steep (I, <0.009), gentle (II, 0.009-0.058), sharp to negative (III)
nodes.note: stage boundaries drawn as dashed lines with labels I, II, III
nodes.detail: o8: Hardening rate drops from ~85 to ~14 GPa by 0.009, falls slowly to ~5 GPa by 0.058, then turns negative
